coverage.summary: Applies to the sale or rental of all property, residential or business. Exceptions: a single unit in an owner-occupied two-family dwelling; rooms in an owner- or occupant-occupied one-family home; same-religion preference by religious organizations; single-sex residences; and, as to familial status, housing for older persons.
coverage.owner_conditions: Rental of a single apartment in a two-family dwelling whose other unit the owner occupies as a residence at the time of rental is exempt.

result.notes: I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the LAD covers ordinary rental property generally. The single-sex residence exemption appears only in the DCA guide (D067), so I listed it separately from the older-persons familial-status exemption, which is supported by D068. D067's wording ties the single-sex exemption to familial status only ambiguously. No unit-count, construction-date or preemption limits are stated.
